emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over CO: Denver city, Colorado Springs city, Aurora city, Thornton city, and Arvada city and 36 other communities sit under SPC's **Elevated** fire-weather category. USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 10% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
